evidence.title: Migrating from v1 | React Highlight Popover

name: React Highlight Popover
summary: Headless React component that shows a popover when text is selected, with placement and collision handling.
description: A headless component that watches text selections inside its children and renders your own popover next to the selection. It handles placement, alignment, offsets, collision handling, portals, keyboard and ARIA behaviour, and can close on Escape. You write the popover markup; about 2.4 kB gzipped with no dependencies besides React.
contains: headless React component, ~2.4 kB gzipped, no dependencies besides React
placement, alignment, offset, collision handling and portal support
migration guide from v1 to v2
